scientific_limitations: The theorem is confined to finite-dimensional centered Gaussian vectors whose coordinate marginals have positive variance.
The covariance-simplex lower bound need not equal the exact nonlinear copositivity coefficient.
It does not classify non-Gaussian distributions or establish uniqueness of Stein-type transformations.
title: Strict copositivity exactly characterizes Gaussian distribution-copositivity
